sprint: Image Studio Ship B — Contextual-Collapse Redo. Direct product rejection (verbatim): 'do you really think this is the best implementation you can think. to remove the scroll you overlayed on main area ??' The prior UX Refinement ship reparented sub-panels onto `.picture-studio-stage` as an absolute-positioned floating overlay to eliminate a right-pane scrollbar — a real trade-off in the wrong direction, since it obscured the very canvas a Story Author was trying to paint on. Reverted the overlay entirely: `_editPanel.appendChild(subWrap)` restored (sub-panels live back in the right pane, `position:static`, no z-index), overlay CSS block (`.picture-studio-subpanels{position:absolute;bottom;z-index;pointer-events}` + sub-panel active state's `box-shadow`/`backdrop-filter`/`pointer-events:auto`) removed as dead code. Real fix is contextual collapse: when a tool is active, CSS hides every tile NOT relevant to that tool via a new `data-tile-key` attribute filter — brush keeps 3 tiles (removeMore/bringBack/oops, one logical toolkit: erase/restore/undo); crop/flip/reset keep just their own tile. New always-visible '✓ Done' button appears only when a tool is engaged, pill-styled gold matching the primary CTA convention, clicking calls `_toggleActiveTool(null)` — one focused thing at a time, structurally guaranteed to fit without scroll because there's less content in the pane when collapsed, and nothing ever overlaps the canvas. Edit hint retitles per active tool via new `_EDIT_HINTS` map ('Tap a tool, then touch your picture.' → 'Pick a brush size, then paint on your picture.' / 'Drag on your picture to choose what to keep.' / etc.) wired in `_toggleActiveTool`. Two module-level `let` declarations added for `_editHint`/`_editDoneBtn` (fixing a real implicit-global bug the prior ship's Edit 3 left behind — `editHint` had been changed from `const editHint = ...` to `_editHint = ...` without also adding the top-level `let`). Sub-panel padding tightened from `12px 14px` → `10px 12px` and gap from `8px` → `6px`; edit-view padding from `14px 16px` → `12px 14px`, gap `10px` → `8px` — closes the residual overflow at a short 700px viewport (48px → 0). Cache-bust bumped ?v=0313→?v=0314 across every script/link tag in root index.html.
task: Verified end-to-end via a new 56-assertion Playwright suite (scratch-only, `contextual_collapse_verify.js`) at TWO viewport heights (1400×900 and 1400×700): subWrap parent IS `_editPanel` (not stage); subWrap has NO `position:absolute` and NO explicit z-index; '✓ Done' button present, HIDDEN by default (no active tool) via CSS `display:none`; every tile has `data-tile-key` set (8 total: removeMore/bringBack/crop/flip/oops/brighten/peek/reset); brush activation sets `data-active-tool='brush'`, shows Done as `display:block`, shows brush sub-panel as `display:flex`, retitles edit hint, hides everything but the removeMore/bringBack/oops tiles (verified: exactly those 3 alphabetized as ['bringBack','oops','removeMore']); brush sub-panel's rendered rect does NOT geometrically overlap the canvas (`.picture-studio-canvas`), verified via `getBoundingClientRect()` on both — brush at {left:877,right:1164,top:413,bottom:653} vs canvas at {left:236,right:844,top:169,bottom:731} — the two rects share no interior points since brush.left > canvas.right; Done click clears `data-active-tool`, hides Done, restores all 8 tiles, reverts edit hint; crop activation shows only the crop tile + crop sub-panel + retitles hint; right pane does NOT scroll in default state OR while brush is active, at both 900px AND 700px viewports (scrollHeight === clientHeight at every check); zero uncaught page errors. A real test-methodology bug from the prior ship's verification (that suite's `getComputedStyle` reads on a removed element silently returned empty strings) was avoided here by snapshotting everything into a single `probe` object BEFORE `modal.remove()`, then returning that snapshot for outside-page assertions — the whole verification suite passes on the first end-to-end run once the CSS tightening closes the 700px overflow (48px → 0 via one round of padding/gap trims to sub-panel + edit-view, none of which visibly compromise the kid-friendly control size).
